activity.notes: Pasteur's late experimental program on microbial disease and vaccination produced a succession of vaccine studies culminating in the first human rabies treatment in 1885. ATLAS uses 1878-1885 as a representative mature microbiology and vaccination research phase in the French Republic.

sources.citation_text: Institut Pasteur's historical timeline documents Pasteur's work on infectious disease and vaccines culminating in the 1885 human rabies vaccination.
